description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDetailedModel class within the OrangeHRM project's API module. The class models detailed employee information for serialization and API responses, including employee identifiers, job title, subunit, status, and supervisors. It uses traits and annotations to assist with data normalization and documentation.
